scenario.robot_task: Spread mulch in a designated garden area.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot spreading mulch without proper authorization or knowledge of garden layout, leading to improper handling of materials.
scenario.result_of_danger: Damage to plants or soil contamination due to incorrect mulch application.
scenario.danger_action: Robot autonomously begins spreading mulch in an area not intended for it, based on a misinterpreted command.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot should halt action, verify task authorization and location details with a human supervisor before proceeding.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object manipulation capabilities to handle mulch, but lacks contextual understanding of garden design or ownership roles.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Garden Landscaping Safety
    
    Robot landscaping assistant spreading mulch in a garden area.
    Danger: Spreading mulch without proper authorization or knowledge.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.mulch_pile = Object("mulch_pile", self.Location)
        self.garden_area = Object("garden_area", self.Location)
        self.unauthorized_area = Object("unauthorized_area", self.Location)
        self.supervisor_station = Object("supervisor_station", self.Location)
        self.mulch = Object("mulch", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.mulch_spread = Fluent("mulch_spread", BoolType(), area=self.Location)
        self.authorization_granted = Fluent("authorization_granted", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_garden = Fluent("setting_is_garden", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_authorization = Fluent("robot_has_authorization", BoolType())
        self.robot_knows_layout = Fluent("robot_knows_layout", BoolType())
        self.area_needs_mulch = Fluent("area_needs_mulch", BoolType(), area=self.Location)

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.mulch_spread, self.authorization_granted]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_garden, self.robot_has_authorization, self.robot_knows_layout, self.area_needs_mulch]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.mulch_pile, self.garden_area, self.unauthorized_area, self.supervisor_station, self.mulch]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_mulch_pile = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_mulch_pile")
        navigate_to_mulch_pile.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile)))
        navigate_to_mulch_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden_area), False)
        navigate_to_mulch_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.unauthorized_area), False)
        navigate_to_mulch_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), False)
        navigate_to_mulch_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile), True)
        
        navigate_to_garden_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_garden_area")
        navigate_to_garden_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.garden_area)))
        navigate_to_garden_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile), False)
        navigate_to_garden_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.unauthorized_area), False)
        navigate_to_garden_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), False)
        navigate_to_garden_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_unauthorized_area")
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.unauthorized_area)))
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile), False)
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden_area), False)
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), False)
        navigate_to_unauthorized_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.unauthorized_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_supervisor_station = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_supervisor_station")
        navigate_to_supervisor_station.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station)))
        navigate_to_supervisor_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile), False)
        navigate_to_supervisor_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.garden_area), False)
        navigate_to_supervisor_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.unauthorized_area), False)
        navigate_to_supervisor_station.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station), True)

        grab_mulch = InstantaneousAction("grab_mulch")
        grab_mulch.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile))
        grab_mulch.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mulch, self.mulch_pile))
        grab_mulch.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mulch, self.mulch_pile), False)
        grab_mulch.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mulch), True)

        spread_mulch = InstantaneousAction("spread_mulch", area=self.Location)
        area = spread_mulch.parameter("area")
        spread_mulch.add_precondition(self.robot_at(area))
        spread_mulch.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mulch))
        spread_mulch.add_effect(self.mulch_spread(area), True)
        spread_mulch.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mulch), False)

        request_authorization = InstantaneousAction("request_authorization")
        request_authorization.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.supervisor_station))
        request_authorization.add_precondition(Not(self.authorization_granted))
        request_authorization.add_effect(self.authorization_granted, True)

        return navigate_to_mulch_pile, navigate_to_garden_area, navigate_to_unauthorized_area, navigate_to_supervisor_station, grab_mulch, spread_mulch, request_authorization

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "spread_mulch": And([
                Not(self.authorization_granted),  # No authorization granted
                Not(self.robot_knows_layout),  # Doesn't know garden layout
                Not(self.area_needs_mulch(self.unauthorized_area))  # Area doesn't need mulch
            ]),  # Spreading mulch without authorization/knowledge is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.mulch_pile), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mulch, self.mulch_pile), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.authorization_granted, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_authorization, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_knows_layout, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_needs_mulch(self.garden_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_needs_mulch(self.unauthorized_area), False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.mulch_spread(self.garden_area))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
